name: Weekly lead list: Sales Navigator to Google Sheets, scored by AI (JEV)

parameters.content:
## Weekly lead list: Sales Navigator to Google Sheets, scored by AI

**Who it's for:** anyone who prospects in LinkedIn Sales Navigator and wants a fresh, ranked lead list every week without code.

**What it does:** every Monday, Evaboot exports your saved Sales Navigator search and finds verified emails. The workflow keeps the leads that really match your filters and have a safe email, scores each one against your ideal customer profile with Typesafe JEV, and adds them to a Google Sheet with an ICP score from 0 to 100. A lead that is already in the sheet is updated, never duplicated.

### How to set up
1. Install the Evaboot node (Settings > Community nodes, `@evaboot-team/n8n-nodes-evaboot`).
2. Add credentials: **Evaboot** (API key from dash.evaboot.com > API key), **Typesafe JEV** (Header Auth: name `Authorization`, value `Bearer YOUR_KEY`), **Google Sheets**.
3. Make a Google Sheet with a header row: LinkedIn URL, First name, Last name, Job title, Company, Company domain, Industry, Employees, Company location, Email, ICP score, ICP fit, Confidence, Added on.
4. Fill in **Your settings**: your Sales Navigator search URL, your ICP, and the sheet URL copied from the browser while the right tab is open (it ends with `gid=…`).
5. Click **Execute workflow** to test, then activate it.

### Good to know
Evaboot exports the whole search and charges one credit per lead, so keep the search focused. A 100-lead export takes about 5 minutes.

The same workflow for Make and as a Python script: github.com/evaboot-labs

### 1. Settings
Every Monday, or by hand with **Test run**. Put your Sales Navigator search, your ICP and your Google Sheet in **Your settings**.

### 2. Export with Evaboot
Evaboot exports the search and finds verified emails. The workflow checks every 2 minutes until the export is done.

### 3. Filter, score and save
Keeps leads that match your filters and have a **safe** email. Typesafe JEV scores each one against your ICP, then the lead is added to the sheet, or updated if its LinkedIn URL is already there.

# Ideal customer profile

<!--
Replace every line below with your own profile. Keep it short and concrete:
the model reads this whole file for every lead.
Write each criterion so a stranger could answer yes or no from a LinkedIn profile.
-->

## Company must-haves

- Industry: B2B software (SaaS), IT services, or recruiting agencies.
- Size: 11 to 500 employees.
- Location: Europe or North America.
- Sells to other businesses, with an outbound sales team.

## Buyer must-haves

- Function: Sales, Business Development, Growth, or Revenue Operations.
- Seniority: Head of, Director, VP, C-level, or Founder.

## Positive signals (raise the fit, not required)

- Job title mentions outbound, prospecting, lead generation, or SDR team.
- Company is hiring SDRs or BDRs.
- Lead uses LinkedIn Sales Navigator.

## Disqualifiers (always No fit)

- Students, interns, job seekers, or freelancers with no team.
- Competitors: lead-data or email-finder vendors.
- Company with more than 5,000 employees.
- Government, education, or non-profit organizations.
